groups.contract: Building compile cache and deferred scene mutation
groups.analysis: Cache matches program+detail, compiles geometry before storing Arc levels. Taking a prepared recipe consumes it before later compilation can reject; request is regenerable from immutable program, so this is not assumed lost durable authority. Prepared-versus-replicated fixtures personally read cover equivalent origin/material/vertices and consumed resident recipes, not run. Scene vista clears owner pending GPU queue and despawns scene-owned distant presentations before fallible replacement iteration: preserves no whole-scene atomicity claim, requires connected streaming/publication owner analysis. Dynamic insertion queues visibility/prepared removal only after interior option succeeds in argument evaluation.

groups.contract: Boundary mesh batching and exact support
groups.analysis: Placement intentionally uses gate elevation for distant scene-space mesh and parent gate for relative mesh. Individual cell mesh checks completed position/UV finite, skips nonfinite triangle normals (documented coincident faces), tangent generation/merge errors propagate; members increments only after merge success. Native centroid sum/normal cross can overflow finite extreme geometry and differ from documented zero-area skip; exact admitted huge-cell producer not established. Tests personally read preserve native vertices+datum and finite normal/tangent output for ordinary fixtures, not run. Scene digest mismatch retains pending request. Once digest matches, pending is taken before boundary projection and later mesh/door fallibility, so failure consumes automatic retry; exact failing admitted scene and intended failure-vs-retry policy remain open, not ordinary failure finding.

groups.contract: GPU candidate assembly ownership and packing
groups.analysis: PendingGpuCities is per PresentationOwner; publication frame remains pending and actual root must exist. Component index u32 narrowing and bit capacity reject before component record insertion. Packing builds local geometry/building/range candidates; upload checks all source materials before asset allocations and entity creation. On assembly failure pending queue is consumed and optional candidate root gets CityAssemblyFailure, previous active GPU scene retained. No claim failure automatically retries or clears old READY; actual candidate-root readiness must decide. On success source props/entities removed only after upload and then old batches replaced/despawned. Empty candidate explicitly resets owner and acknowledges exact root. Raw building/range count casts and byte/count sums need producer capacity proof; no >u32/memory-size live witness claimed. Prototype identity is compiled Arc+palette infill handle, assuming full appearance palette determined by that handle; exact material producer remains next frontier.
